title: "God of mercy, teach my heart to listen when You warn me. Help me master what seeks to master me."
paragraphs: "God of mercy, teach my heart to listen when You warn me. Help me master what seeks to master me."

When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there—witnessing the truth unfold.
I stay hidden, barely breathing, as the moment breaks open.
Jealousy moves faster than reason. Anger hardens into action.
And the ground receives what never should have been given.

I am only a witness, not part of the story—yet my heart aches as if it were.
How quietly sin grows when it isn’t faced. How swiftly resentment becomes ruin.
God warned Cain that desire was crouching at the door… and still, it ruled him.

As I watch from the shadows, I ask myself:
What do I do with the anger I carry before it carries me?
